title: Syntrophus aciditrophicus RNA sequencing data
description: Syntrophus aciditrophicus is a syntrophic bacterium that degrades key intermediates during anaerobic decomposition, such as, benzoate, cyclohexane-1-carboxylate, and fatty acids to acetate when grown with hydrogen/formate-consuming microorganism. In this study the transcriptomes of S. aciditrophicus grown in pure culture on crotonate, and coculture with Methanospirillum hungatei on crotonate, cyclohexane-1-carboxylate, and benzoate were sequenced using Illumina sequencing to determine whether or not a central metabolic pathway was reponsible for degradation of its substrates and formation of alicyclic and aromatic rings. In addition, transcriptomic studies were performed to deduce the enzymes responsible for ATP formation via substrate-level phosphorylation.
